testResults.name: paper-shell-focused
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/harness/runtime/test_paper_shell.py
testResults.result: 15 passed: mock-live 3-hour inbox session with AT_CLOSE status and intact books, paper/backtest parity (identical event stream and fill config produce equal fills/fee_assessments/portfolio/dispatch_hash), halt/abort/teardown policies, risk rejection, extra latency, multi-strategy book routing, step-driven shutdown, feed and config validation

testResults.name: repository-wide-quality-gates
testResults.result: Repository-wide gates and 1242-test pytest suite passed after wave integration

limitations: Reuses backtest internals (_RiskVenue, _GuardedBinding) deliberately for behavioral identity; the duck-typed engine protocol seam is a candidate later formalization
Kernel requires globally non-decreasing (timestamp, sequence) at the boundary; live inboxes must be pre-merged by the feed layer
